document_scope: independent source and userspace handoff review; raw test 009 proof was not read and is not incorporated

candidate.bootargs: -v -s debug=0x14e keepsyms=1 serial=3 serial-device-name=uart0 disable-uart-irq=1 cpus=1 rd=md0

runtime_reported_by_root.scope: Root reported these facts. This review did not read the serial log or boot the target.
runtime_reported_by_root.challenge_not_sent_reason: host tail matcher rejected the ANSI/NUL/bracketed-paste-mode trailer

libmalloc.observed_effect: nonfatal mvm_protect warnings on guard pages; PID 3 still started
libmalloc.warning_text_scope: Astra: the warning prints the unrounded requested address

source_chain.step: boot-arg -s sets RB_SINGLE and execs /sbin/launchd with argv -s
launchctl opens /dev/console, calls login_tty, then execl(/bin/sh, "-sh")
/bin/sh rewrites argv[0] to sh and execs /private/var/select/sh, which the virt-minimal image points at /bin/zsh

prompt_source.bracketed_paste_and_ansi: Root named that trailer as the host matcher miss. /etc/zshrc does not disable bracketed paste. pd-console-login is not on this path.

not_the_single_user_path.pd_console_login: /usr/libexec/pd-console-login is a LaunchDaemon. launchctl does not reach later bootstrap jobs until the single-user shell exits 0.
not_the_single_user_path.etc_ttys: image.nix writes /etc/ttys as /dev/console /bin/zsh -l. The -s path does not consult it.

conclusion: Root reports the ext4 md0 root, launchd, launchctl, and a zsh prompt with no panic. That is the userspace handoff. The Darwin command-line challenge was not sent and is not observed. No rootfs change follows from this review.
